place.description: A shuttered student dorm. Viewers swear a figure stands behind you in every stream.

ghosts.description: A man-shaped absence at the edge of your flashlight. It only moves when you are not looking.
A giant smoking a cigar in the trees. Mostly curious — until you trespass.

items.description: Coarse salt in a cloth pouch. Ghosts cannot cross a line of it.
Worn wooden beads, warm to the touch.
A faded staff portrait. One face has been scratched out.
A tall white candle. The flame leans toward spirits.
A carved charm inscribed with old protective words.
